buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The contract is for a period of one year initially and can be extended upto one year based on the perfor mance of the service provider on mutual consent. 2. The Security Deposit of 5% of the bid value should be submitted in the form of Demand Draft in favour o f ESIC Fund A/c No. 1, Payable at Tirunelveli. 3. Payment shall be made on quarterly basis based on the satisfactory performance of the service provide r after submission of invoice and service reports as per the bid requirements. PEST CONTROL SERVICES 1) Pest control is an integral component of sanitation services. The following types of pest control services shall be provided by the contractor: S.NO Types of pest control Description No. of treatment s in 01 year 1 Rodent control Eliminating and preventing rat and mo 52 use infestations using glue Pads/bait- s tickers /etc. 2 Cockroach/Mosquito ,lizar Removal and prevention of cockroache 52 d, Spider and ANT control s, Lizards, Spiders and through baiting, gel based or spray treatment etc. 3 Vector control Controlling mosquito, flies, bees and ot 52 her flying insects. 4 Snake control Using non- lethal chemicals which act a As required s a repellent when applied on the perip hery of building. Responsible for remov al of snacks from inside the hospital bo undary wall ,if found.

5 Pigeon/Bird control and A Preventive and control measures for pi As required nimal control geon, birds and stray animals within ho spital permises as per requirement. 2)The pest control services shall be generally provided for the basement and three floors of the hospital wi th total plinth area of 8832(area in sq. mt) However, any area within the boundary walls of the hospital pre mises shall be treated for pest control, as and when required by the hospital. 3)For pest control services, only those chemicals should be used in hospital setting, which are fit for usage in healthcare setting. Details of chemicals should contain - Name of chemical, Name of company, Concentr ation, Chemical composition, Quantity consumed, Size of packing, Batch no., Manufacturing & Expiry date. 28 4)All Chemicals shall be provided by the contractor. The chemicals must be certified by WHOPES, CIB or BI S. The contingency and evacuation plan must exist for chemical overdose. A small stock of antidote shall b e maintained by the contractor onsite. 5)There shall be no open baiting. Periodicity of spraying chemicals shall be done to ensure the quality of t he pest control. 6) The contractor shall employ experienced & certified pest technicians for the work of pest control. 7) The contractor shall share the technician details to the hospital administration before each visit for pest control. The hospital will provide free access to all parts of the premises to the contractor for conducting in spection and treatment. 8) The pest control should be performed during hours with minimum risk to patients and staff as per requi rement of the hospital; post-treatment cleaning being mandatory. 9) The logbook and service reports copy for all pest control treatments must be maintained onsite and be available with the Caretaker for inspection on demand. The original service reports along with copy of logb ook must be presented with the monthly bill for pest control services. 10) If a relapse occurs during the warranty period, the contractor is obligated to provide a free-of-cost serv ice to remove the pests. This service must be provided within one day of the complaint raised by the hospi tal. 11) The contractor shall be responsible to arrange its own manpower, tools, chemicals, etc. required for p est control services. The payment for pest control shall be made on the basis of price quoted as per Financ ial Bid and that will include charges for all the above components of service/ pest control treatments. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS AREA OF WORK: 8832 (area in sq. mt) All open and covered area within the boundary of the ESIC Hospital Tirunelveli-and- including the basemen ts, open areas, terraces and roof will be in the scope of Pest Control services to be provided by the contrac tor. 1)Pest and Rodent Control Services: (a) The entire hospital including parking spaces, drive ways, wards, ICUs, office rooms, store rooms, sterile areas, Operation theatres etc. are included in the scope of contract for Pest and Rodent Control Services. (b) The Contractor shall take effective measures for Rodent, Lizards, other reptiles and Disinfection Servic es including fogging etc. in the area under contract at least once a week. (c) The contract shall do regular fogging in and around entire campus to prevent mosquito menace as per requirement but not less than once in a week.

(d) The Contractor shall use chemicals that are harmless to humans and machines and treated area. MSD S (Material Safety data Sheet) report of these chemicals should also be attached. These chemicals, tools r equired for pest and rodent control and man power needed has to be arranged by the contractor himself. (e) The Contractor will be responsible for any damage to human/machinery by any chemicals used by him . Any damage caused to machinery/books due to rodent and disinfection services in the areas covered und er contract shall be made borne by the Contractor. (f) The Contractor will submit a detailed plan for carrying out the Pest and Rodent Control Services for the approval of ESIC Hospital Tirunelveli. (g) The contractor shall provide good quality gum pads/metal cage traps/pepper mint oil for rodents at pl aces/sites as and where required. (h) In case of any fault event of sighting /notice/ occurrence of pest, rodent infestation a penalty of Rs. 1,0 00/- (Rupees One thousand only) shall be levied on every such occasion. 2. Pest Control Monitoring and Control: For better management and smooth services, the following monitoring mechanism will be adopted by the Contractor: (a) Management / Pest Control Service Requirements/ Complaints Report: This is to be filled up by the man agement and administrative staff of the Contractor who receive/observe the complaints/requirements for a ny of the services. All suggestions, complaints related to services or staff deployed by the Contractor will b e registered at site on the computer/register provided to the Contractor and reported to Caretaker, ESIC. T he Contractor will take immediate action to resolve the same failing which the Penalty of Rs. 1000/- per co mplaint will be invoked. (b) Pest Control Services Complaint Register: This register is to be completed on the basis of information re ceived by the Pest Control Manager from ESIC officials through the inspection of the site, material on site, necessary action is to be taken. attendance sheet of the staff, weekly report, client letter/fax/e-mail, verba l complaints from ESIC, etc. S.
